persona: Export documentation assistant at a textile exporter moving into an EXIM compliance role
resumeText:
Nisha Patel | Ahmedabad | nisha.patel@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Export Documentation Executive, Sabarmati Textiles Ltd, Ahmedabad (2022 - present)
- Prepared commercial invoices, packing lists and certificate of origin for about 40 export shipments a month.
- Checked shipping bills filed on ICEGATE by our customs broker against invoices and HS code classification.
- Filed RoDTEP claims and duty drawback follow-ups for all export shipments on the customs portal.
- Prepared export documents under letters of credit and resolved bank discrepancies.
- Coordinated with the CHA and freight forwarder coordination for container bookings and vessel cut-offs.
- Kept the shipment and incentive tracker in Excel for the commercial head.

Accounts Assistant, Navrang Traders, Ahmedabad (2020 - 2022)
- Posted purchase and sales entries in Tally.

SKILLS
EPCG, e-BRC, SAP

EDUCATION
B.Com, Gujarat University, 2020
